paragraphs: Good morning, everyone! This is our weather report for the week. I am Lily, and this is Tom. Tom shows the clothes for every day. The whole class watches us. On Monday, the weather is sunny and hot. There is a big sun in the sky. Tom wears a hat and shorts. "Is it always hot?" asks Tom. "No," I say. "Look at Tuesday!"

On Tuesday, there is rain. The ground is wet. The rain is loud on the roof. Tom wears a coat and boots. On Wednesday, it is cloudy. There are gray clouds, but there is no rain. It is a little cold, so Tom wears a sweater. On Thursday, it is windy. The wind is strong! "Hold your hat!" says Tom. I laugh. The children in the class clap.

On Friday morning, there is rain again. In the afternoon, the sun comes out. Then there is a big rainbow in the sky! It has red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple. What is the weather today, class? Is it sunny, cloudy, or windy? Look out of the window. Tom takes off his coat and smiles. "I like all weather, with the right clothes!" he says.
